extensionDescription.message: Fill the YouTube tab with a centered cover crop while keeping the browser chrome visible.

optionsTagline.message: Centered cover mode for YouTube videos.

shortcutHelp.message: In-page shortcut: º by default, intended for Spanish keyboards where the key is to the left of 1. If you use another keyboard layout, record a different shortcut here. This shortcut only works when the YouTube tab has focus. To use a shortcut from other apps, set the native browser command to Global in chrome://extensions/shortcuts or brave://extensions/shortcuts.

statusInvalid.message: Press a normal key or a combination with Ctrl, Alt or Shift.
